title: finetune-vs-api-sft
subtitle: MASSIVE 1.1 en-US as OpenAI chat-format SFT records
description: sft_train.jsonl and sft_dev.jsonl: the train and dev splits of MASSIVE 1.1 (en-US) as OpenAI chat-format records ({"messages": [system, user, assistant]}), where the assistant turn is the labelled JSON function call. Derived from MASSIVE (Amazon, CC BY 4.0), whose English text comes from SLURP (CC BY 4.0). Change made: the [label : value] slot annotations were converted to JSON. Attribution and citations: NOTICE.md in the finetune-vs-api repository. Licence: CC BY 4.0, given as 'other' because it is stated here rather than chosen from Kaggle's list. Prepared by scripts/prepare_data.py. The test split is not included.
